TOUHOUANCIENTS-ZHANGEWEILAIBA.title: Foresight X
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ZHANGEWEILAIBA.descriptio: Upon pickup, choose an [blue]X[/blue]-cost card from your character pool and add it to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The effects of your cost [blue]X[/blue] cards are increased by [blue]{Increase}[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ZHANGEWEILAIBA.eventDescr: Choose an [blue]X[/blue]-cost card from your character pool and add it to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The effects of your cost [blue]X[/blue] cards are increased by [blue]{Increase}[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ZHANGEWEILAIBA.flavor: Who needs foresight? I want it now!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BILEIHAOPAIDUOZHUA.title: Towering Barricade
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BILEIHAOPAIDUOZHUA.descri: Upon pickup, add [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Barricade+[/gold] cards [gold]enchanted[/gold] with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Whenever you add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold] that already shares a name with a card in it, [gold]enchant[/gold] that card with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BILEIHAOPAIDUOZHUA.eventD: Add [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Barricade+[/gold] cards [gold]enchanted[/gold] with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Whenever you add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold] that already shares a name with a card in it, [gold]enchant[/gold] that card with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BILEIHAOPAIDUOZHUA.flavor: Barricade is a great card. Pick some more!
Upon pickup, remove [blue]4[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold], then copy all Defends in your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [green]Upgrade[/green] them.
Remove [blue]4[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold], then copy all Defends in your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [green]Upgrade[/green] them.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GEISHEHUAXIAOJIE.title: Withered Snake Plant
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GEISHEHUAXIAOJIE.descript: At the start of each combat, ALL enemies lose [blue]{StrengthLose}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. Whenever you play a card, ALL enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], up to [blue]{StrengthLose}[/blue] times per enemy.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GEISHEHUAXIAOJIE.flavor: Let's reduce Miss Snake Plant's Strength a bit, shall we?
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HUOYANTUXI.title: Purifying Flame
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HUOYANTUXI.description: When attacked, deal [blue]{FlameBarrierPower}[/blue] damage to the attacker.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HUOYANTUXI.flavor: Guys, that Flame Barrier damage is insane!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SHEYAOTEBIEQIANG.title: Sky-Devouring Snecko Fang
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SHEYAOTEBIEQIANG.descript: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]SnakeBite[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] all cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold] and future cards with "Snake" in their name with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SHEYAOTEBIEQIANG.eventDes: Add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]SnakeBite[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] all cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold] and future cards with "Snake" in their name with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SHEYAOTEBIEQIANG.flavor: SnakeBite — the greatest card in Sts2, no contest!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YIYANDINGZHEN.title: Snecko's True Gaze
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YIYANDINGZHEN.description: Start each combat [red]Confused[/red]. At the start of your turn, choose a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It is free to play this turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YIYANDINGZHEN.flavor: One True Gaze confirms it: way too costly.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YIYANDINGZHEN.selectionSc: Choose a card to make it free this turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YISHIXINGQILE.title: Impulse Purchase
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YISHIXINGQILE.description: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. After spending at the Merchant, [blue]1~2[/blue] random items for sale have their price reduced to [blue]0[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YISHIXINGQILE.eventDescri: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. After spending at the Merchant, [blue]1~2[/blue] random items for sale have their price reduced to [blue]0[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YISHIXINGQILE.flavor: Spend money to make... more spending money!
At the start of each combat, gain {PlatingPower} [gold]Plating[/gold]. Whenever you gain [gold]Plating[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DONGNICHANGSHU.title: The Permanence Fifteen
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DONGNICHANGSHU.descriptio: The first time your [gold]Block[/gold] exceeds [blue]{BlockLimit}[/blue] each turn, reduce your [gold]Block[/gold] to [blue]{BlockLimit}[/blue], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}, and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DONGNICHANGSHU.flavor: There's a Bowlbug on your lawn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MORIYA_GOHEI.title: Moriya Gohei
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MORIYA_GOHEI.description: Upon pickup, choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MORIYA_GOHEI.eventDescrip: Choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MORIYA_GOHEI.flavor: You can't be bound by common sense.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DAY_KAKUSEI.title: Daytime Guest Stars
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DAY_KAKUSEI.description: At the start of each combat, gain a [gold]Power Potion[/gold]. [gold]Upgrade[/gold] any [gold]Power[/gold] cards you generate.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DAY_KAKUSEI.flavor: How about turning it into gamma rays?
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SNAKE_AMULET.title: Snake Amulet
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SNAKE_AMULET.description: If you have [blue]1[/blue] or fewer cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] at the end of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SNAKE_AMULET.flavor: They say carrying this charm keeps you healthy and strong.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FROG_AMULET.title: Frog Amulet
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FROG_AMULET.description: After you deal damage with a card, deal [gold]{ExtraDamage:percentLess()}%[/gold] of that damage to ALL enemies at the end of your next turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FROG_AMULET.flavor: They say carrying this charm ensures you return home safely.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SAILOR_SUIT.title: Sailor Suit
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SAILOR_SUIT.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold]. When you would gain [gold]Frail[/gold], [gold]Weak[/gold], or [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], instead become immune and apply the same amount to ALL enemies.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SAILOR_SUIT.flavor: No one can resist the charm of a girl in a sailor suit!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GIFT_FROM_MOUNTAIN.title: Gift from God's Mountain
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GIFT_FROM_MOUNTAIN.flavor: Believe in the [aqua]Moriya Shrine[/aqua] and receive a newcomer gift pack. — Bunbunmaru
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MIRACLE_NOBLE.title: Miracle Covenant
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MIRACLE_NOBLE.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Miracle of the Sea Opening[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MIRACLE_NOBLE.eventDescri: Add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Miracle of the Sea Opening[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MIRACLE_NOBLE.flavor: Want to know what's on the other side of the sea? Just go take a look.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WIND_PRIESTESS_WINE.title: Wind Priestess Wine
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WIND_PRIESTESS_WINE.flavo: Minty and creamy. More like a dessert than a drink.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HISOUTENSOKU_MODEL.title: Hisoutensoku Model
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HISOUTENSOKU_MODEL.descri: At the start of each combat, choose [blue]{SelectCount}[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [green]Upgraded[/green] [gold]The Defect[/gold] cards to add to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. They are free to play this combat.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HISOUTENSOKU_MODEL.flavor: A lone hero bearing everyone's expectations, standing alone against Gremlin Nob. When it swings its righteous iron fist, the Spire is bathed in the light of hope. Let us call out its name——"Defect"!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DRACULA_LEGACY.title: Dracula's Legacy
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DRACULA_LEGACY.descriptio: Upon pickup, gain [blue]6[/blue] random relics. For each relic not gained this way, lose [blue]{Damage}[/blue] HP (minimum [blue]1[/blue] HP).
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DRACULA_LEGACY.eventDescr: Gain [blue]6[/blue] random relics. For each relic not gained this way, lose [blue]{Damage}[/blue] HP (minimum [blue]1[/blue] HP).
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DRACULA_LEGACY.flavor: Remilia Scarlet is not a descendant of Dracula. But some treasures were indeed gifted by that Count.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-NIGHT_SERVANT.title: Night Servant
TOUHOUANCIENTS-NIGHT_SERVANT.description: Your [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] additionally contain one of [gold]Time Minion[/gold], [gold]Magic Minion[/gold], or [gold]Qi Minion[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-NIGHT_SERVANT.flavor: A servant's dignity is part of [jitter]her master's dignity[/jitter]. —Remilia Scarlet
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CRIMSON_CHALICE.title: Crimson Chalice
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CRIMSON_CHALICE.descripti: Upon pickup, double your Max HP. Add [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Decay[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CRIMSON_CHALICE.eventDesc: Double your Max HP. Add [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Decay[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CRIMSON_CHALICE.flavor: Mistress only drinks [red]Type B blood[/red]. —Sakuya Izayoi
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLOOD_FANG.title: Blood Fang
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLOOD_FANG.description: Upon pickup, lose half of your Max HP. Choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLOOD_FANG.eventDescripti: Lose half of your Max HP. Choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLOOD_FANG.flavor: She always spills so much blood when she drinks, staining her dress a deep [red]crimson[/red].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CRIMSON_CRYSTAL.title: Crimson Crystal
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CRIMSON_CRYSTAL.descripti: At the start of each turn, if your HP is at least [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CRIMSON_CRYSTAL.flavor: One of Remilia's treasures, with a blood-red color more vivid than any ruby in the world — though no phantom thief has ever set their sights on it.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SPEAR_GUNGNIR.title: Gungnir
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SPEAR_GUNGNIR.description:
Upon pickup, add a [gold]Spear "Gungnir"[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
When you deal damage or gain [gold]Block[/gold] with cards other than [gold]Spear "Gungnir"[/gold], apply equal [gold]Block[/gold] to the target/ALL enemies.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SPEAR_GUNGNIR.eventDescri: Add a [gold]Spear "Gungnir"[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. When you deal damage or gain [gold]Block[/gold] with cards other than [gold]Spear "Gungnir"[/gold], apply equal [gold]Block[/gold] to the target/ALL enemies.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SPEAR_GUNGNIR.flavor: Gathers aura into a spear-like projectile and hurls it. With immense piercing power, it tears through most danmaku and impales the enemy in a single strike.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LORDS_SUNSCREEN_CREAM.des: All cards in combat rewards are replaced with [gold]Rare[/gold] cards, and you may [gold]Take All[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LORDS_SUNSCREEN_CREAM.fla: Only immature vampires use parasols. Mature vampires have their maids apply sunscreen first.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PRESERVED_RED_FOG.title: Preserved Red Fog
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PRESERVED_RED_FOG.descrip: Upon pickup, duplicate [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Add a [red]Folly[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PRESERVED_RED_FOG.eventDe: Duplicate [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Add a [red]Folly[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PRESERVED_RED_FOG.flavor: To surpass the so-called 'First Devil's' masterpiece 'Preserved Living Mist,' Remilia had me make this overnight. —Patchouli Knowledge
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PRESERVED_RED_FOG.selecti: Choose [blue]{Amount}[/blue] cards to [gold]Duplicate[/gold]. Add a [red]Folly[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-NOBLE_BROOCH.title: Noble Brooch
TOUHOUANCIENTS-NOBLE_BROOCH.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Transform[/gold] up to [blue]2[/blue] cards, then you may [gold]Transform[/gold] those cards again.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-NOBLE_BROOCH.flavor: Accept or defy your fate? Make your choice.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-THE_THIRD_EYE.title: The Third Eye
TOUHOUANCIENTS-THE_THIRD_EYE.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Scry[/gold] [blue]5[/blue], and add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Eye of Satori[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-THE_THIRD_EYE.flavor: Ordinary people can act freely only because they cannot read each other's hearts.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HELL_ORIN.title: Hell's Cat Cart
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HELL_ORIN.description: Whenever a non-minion enemy dies, gain [blue]{[gold]Corpse[/gold]PerKill}[/blue] [gold]Corpse[/gold], {Energy:energyIcons()} and heal [blue]{HealPerKill}[/blue] HP. You may [purple]Reignite[/purple] at [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HELL_ORIN.flavor: A Gothic-clad black cat prowls the streets of Former Hell, ferrying the bodies and souls of the departed on their final journey.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HELL_OKUU.title: Hell's Crow Feathers
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HELL_OKUU.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.  If you end your turn with [blue]0[/blue] {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, add a [gold]Burn[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and gain [blue]{Strength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HELL_OKUU.flavor: The empty-headed hell crow accepted the mountain's energy, her delusions swelling her ignorant ambitions before they could cool.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MIND_PROBE.title: Mind Probe
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MIND_PROBE.description: After an enemy's attack is fully blocked by you, [gold]Stun[/gold] that enemy. Once per enemy per combat.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MEMORY_FLASK.title: Memory Flask
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MEMORY_FLASK.description: Upon pickup, choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MEMORY_FLASK.eventDescrip: Choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BRAIN_IN_A_VAT.title: Brain in a Vat
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BRAIN_IN_A_VAT.descriptio: Upon pickup, choose any number of cards from [blue]{Cards}[/blue] of your current character's cards. These cards will not appear in future [gold]Card Rewards or the Merchant[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BRAIN_IN_A_VAT.eventDescr: Choose any number of cards from [blue]{Cards}[/blue] of your current character's cards. These cards will not appear in future [gold]Card Rewards or the Merchant[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BRAIN_IN_A_VAT.flavor: Does a soul trapped in a corner, unable to control its own body, feel lonely?
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BRAIN_IN_A_VAT.selectionS: Choose any number of cards to exclude from future [gold]Card Rewards and the Merchant[/gold]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BRAIN_IN_A_VAT.forgetNoth: You have not forgotten any cards yet.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DUSTY_ROSE.title: Dusty Rose
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DUSTY_ROSE.description: At the start of your turn, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Closed Eye[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DUSTY_ROSE.flavor: The door to her room in the Palace of the Earth Spirits is never closed, yet even as the roses wilt and dust gathers, her lively yet hazy figure never appears.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BITTER_COFFEE.title: Energizing Coffee
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BITTER_COFFEE.description: The first time your {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} reaches [blue]0[/blue] each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BITTER_COFFEE.flavor: Bitter work calls for something sweet — hence, coffee with sugar.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-OBLIVION_FRAGMENT.title: Oblivion Fragment
TOUHOUANCIENTS-OBLIVION_FRAGMENT.descrip: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{Relics}[/blue] random [sine][blue]Neow's Starting Relics[/blue][/sine].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DETECTIVE_STORY.title: Mystery Novel
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DETECTIVE_STORY.descripti: Attacks deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] additional damage to enemies not intending to Attack. At the end of your turn, [gold]Retain[/gold] [blue]{RetainCard}[/blue] additional card for each enemy intending to Attack.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DETECTIVE_STORY.flavor: "It is the brain, the little gray cells on which one must rely. One must seek the truth within——not without."——Hercule Poirot
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MINI_SHRINE.title: Mini Shrine
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MINI_SHRINE.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.  Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Tribute[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Your [gold]Gold[/gold] is automatically converted into [gold]Tribute[/gold] progress.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MINI_SHRINE.eventDescript: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.  Add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Tribute[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Your [gold]Gold[/gold] is automatically converted into [gold]Tribute[/gold] progress.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MINI_SHRINE.flavor: No one knows what deity is enshrined within.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DONATE_MONEY_BOX.title: Offerings Box
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DONATE_MONEY_BOX.descript: When you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], gain [blue]{CardRewards}[/blue] [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] and {Gold}~{GoldMax} [gold]Gold[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DONATE_MONEY_BOX.flavor: You can't hear any sound when you shake it.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAKUREI_CHARM.title: Hakurei Charm
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAKUREI_CHARM.description: At the start of combat, choose an option and make a [gold]Wish[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SUBSPACE_HOLE.title: Subspace Hole
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SUBSPACE_HOLE.description: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain [blue]{IntangiblePower}[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SEALING_NEEDLE.title: Sealing Needle
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SEALING_NEEDLE.descriptio: Attacks deal [blue]additional[/blue] damage to [gold]Weak[/gold] enemies equal to their [gold]Weak[/gold] stacks, and apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to the target.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SEALING_NEEDLE.flavor: It's said to also be good for promoting blood circulation.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YIN_YANG_ORB.title: Yin-Yang Orb
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YIN_YANG_ORB.description: Whenever you play a Skill, gain [blue]1[/blue] temporary [gold]Strength[/gold]. Whenever you play an Attack, gain [blue]1[/blue] temporary [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YIN_YANG_ORB.flavor: Taiji gives birth to two opposites.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DUPLEX_BARRIER.title: Duplex Barrier
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DUPLEX_BARRIER.descriptio: You may ignore paths when choosing the next rooms to travel to [blue]{Rooms}[/blue] times. When you enter a combat by ignoring the path, enemies will have only [blue]1[/blue] HP.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DUPLEX_BARRIER.flavor: A mysterious power that can even flip space itself.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAKUREI_AMULET.title: Hakurei Talisman
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAKUREI_AMULET.descriptio: When you take unblocked damage no higher than [blue]{Threshold}[/blue], reduce it to [blue]1[/blue] and decrease the threshold by [blue]1[/blue] for this combat, to a minimum of [blue]{MinThreshold}[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAKUREI_AMULET.flavor: A large batch of talismans hand-drawn by Reimu, but completely unsold due to a lack of worshippers.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAKUREI_GOHEI.title: Hakurei Gohei
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAKUREI_GOHEI.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dream Seal[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAKUREI_GOHEI.flavor: A handy trick for exorcising youkai.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MYSTIC_FORTUNE_PEACH.desc: Whenever you play an Attack, a Skill, and a Power, remove all your negative effects and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MYSTIC_FORTUNE_PEACH.flav: The peaches of heaven are absolutely delicious!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CURSE_BREAKER_QI.title: Heavenly Misfortune Blocker
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CURSE_BREAKER_QI.descript: Upon pickup, gain [blue]9[/blue] random [red]Curses[/red]. You may play [red]Curses[/red] that are normally unplayable. The first time you play a [red]Curse[/red] each turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], {Energy:energyIcons()}, and draw [blue]3[/blue] cards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CURSE_BREAKER_QI.eventDes: Gain [blue]9[/blue] random [red]Curses[/red]. You may play [red]Curses[/red] that are normally unplayable. The first time you play a [red]Curse[/red] each turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], {Energy:energyIcons()}, and draw [blue]3[/blue] cards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CURSE_BREAKER_QI.flavor: A celestial's great fortune can suppress even the most vicious god of calamity's misfortune.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FIRMAMENT_SASH.title: Heavenly Sash
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FIRMAMENT_SASH.descriptio: Whenever you take unblocked damage not caused by yourself, reduce it by up to [blue]{Mitigation}[/blue] and record the amount reduced. At the end of your turn, deal damage equal to the recorded amount to yourself and reset it.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FIRMAMENT_SASH.flavor: It's said to reflect different weather depending on her mood.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SUPREME_HEAVEN_SEAL.title: Supreme Golden Circlet
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SUPREME_HEAVEN_SEAL.descr: Upon pickup, choose an [green]Upgraded[/green] Ancient card and add it to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] no longer drop.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SUPREME_HEAVEN_SEAL.event: Choose an [green]Upgraded[/green] Ancient card and add it to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] no longer drop.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SUPREME_HEAVEN_SEAL.selec: Choose an [green]Upgraded[/green] Ancient card to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HEAVENLY_CLOUD_ROBE.title: Heavenly Hagoromo
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HEAVENLY_CLOUD_ROBE.descr: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{BuffAmount}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].After you play an [gold]Attack[/gold], this effect becomes [blue]{BuffAmount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold];after you play a [gold]Skill[/gold], this effect becomes [blue]{BuffAmount}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HEAVENLY_CLOUD_ROBE.flavo: A hagoromo gifted by the Dragon Palace, identical to what its messengers wear. For Tenshi, this outfit is simply far too troublesome to put on.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HISOU_SWORD.title: Hisou Sword
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HISOU_SWORD.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]All Creation's Hisou[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HISOU_SWORD.flavor: A weapon capable of reading an opponent's temperament, one that only a celestial can fully master.
Whenever you play a Skill, plant a [gold]Keystone[/gold]. Whenever you play an Attack, uproot the [gold]Keystone[/gold], dealing [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies and increasing the [gold]Keystone[/gold]'s damage by [blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue] this combat.
Used to suppress the Oo-Namazu that causes earthquakes... not that Preon has any of those.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HOLY_ARMOR.title: Heavenly Armor
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HOLY_ARMOR.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.  The first [gold]Block[/gold] gained from cards each turn is [purple]halved[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HOLY_ARMOR.flavor: Wearing it lets you enter a state of no thought, feeling no pain... or so they say.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CELESTIAL_INDIFFERENCE.de: At the end of your turn, [green]Upgrade[/green] any cards you obtained this turn and the top card of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CELESTIAL_INDIFFERENCE.fl: Heavenly indifference is the greatest fear of youkai.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HEAVENLY_REVELATION.title: Heavenly Revelation
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HEAVENLY_REVELATION.descr: At the start of the [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, double all your [gold]positive powers[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HEAVENLY_REVELATION.flavo: Let the lowly mortals on earth taste the terrible food of heaven! Then they'll never envy the celestial life again! —Tenshi Hinanawi
TOUHOUANCIENTS-COSMIC_DECREE.title: Heavenly Decree
TOUHOUANCIENTS-COSMIC_DECREE.description: Upon pickup, gain the relic: [gold]Divine Right[/gold]. See [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [green]Upgraded[/green] cards from [gold]{Character}[/gold]. Choose any number of them to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-COSMIC_DECREE.eventDescri: Gain the relic: [gold]Divine Right[/gold]. See [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [green]Upgraded[/green] cards from [gold]{Character}[/gold]. Choose any number of them to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-COSMIC_DECREE.flavor: Deigning to keep company with ordinary mortals is also a celestial's duty, after all.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-COSMIC_DECREE.selectionSc: Select any number of cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WHITE_RABBIT_AMULET.title: Inaba Amulet
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WHITE_RABBIT_AMULET.descr: Upon pickup, remove all non-Eternal [red]Curses[/red] from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Prevent [red]Curses[/red] from being added to your [gold]Deck[/gold] afterwards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WHITE_RABBIT_AMULET.event: Remove all non-Eternal [red]Curses[/red] from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Prevent [red]Curses[/red] from being added to your [gold]Deck[/gold] afterwards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WHITE_RABBIT_AMULET.flavo: A common talisman for warding off evil spirits, made more valuable with a rabbit motif.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CARROT_NECKLACE.title: Carrot Necklace
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CARROT_NECKLACE.descripti: Upon pickup, remove up to [blue]3[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The Merchant's card removal fee is doubled.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CARROT_NECKLACE.eventDesc: Remove up to [blue]3[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The Merchant's card removal fee is doubled.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CARROT_NECKLACE.flavor: Wearing this necklace makes you as agile and cunning as a rabbit.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RABBIT_HORN_CONTRACT.desc: Upon pickup, gain [blue]150[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and add a [red]Debt[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. At the end of each combat, gain [blue]20%[/blue] of your current [gold]Gold[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RABBIT_HORN_CONTRACT.even: Gain [blue]150[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], add a [red]Debt[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. At the end of each combat, gain [blue]20%[/blue] of your current [gold]Gold[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RABBIT_HORN_CONTRACT.flav: Red-and-white and black-and-white types are forbidden from signing.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LUCKY_TREASURE_CHEST.desc: Upon pickup, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Potion Slots[/gold] and fill your [gold]Potion Belt[/gold] with [gold]Lucky Tonic[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LUCKY_TREASURE_CHEST.even: Gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Potion Slots[/gold] and fill your [gold]Potion Belt[/gold] with [gold]Lucky Tonic[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LUCKY_TREASURE_CHEST.flav: Half of those who bought this chest reportedly returned it.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FOUR_LEAF_CLOVER.title: Four-Leaf Clover
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FOUR_LEAF_CLOVER.descript: Every [blue]2[/blue] combats, your [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] additionally contain a [gold]Rare[/gold] card. The second [gold]Rare[/gold] card obtained this way will be [green]Upgraded[/green].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FOUR_LEAF_CLOVER.flavor: Those who meet her become lucky, but only the fortunate can meet her.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GLOWING_BAMBOO.title: Glowing Bamboo
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GLOWING_BAMBOO.descriptio: The First card you play each combat will be [green]Upgraded[/green] after the combat ends.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GLOWING_BAMBOO.flavor: A natural phenomenon... or lunar technology? Shh! That's a trade secret.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RABBITS_FOOT.title: Fake Rabbit's Foot
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RABBITS_FOOT.flavor: Oh no, my card rewards are pretty lousy! Well... why not sell them to the Rabbit Horn Alliance!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RABBITS_CAGE.title: Rabbit Cage
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RABBITS_CAGE.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Lucky White Rabbit[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RABBITS_CAGE.flavor: Aren't these little ones adorable? Even celestials think so—just be sure to treat them well~ —Tewi Inaba
TOUHOUANCIENTS-OOKUNINESHI_PROTRAYAL.des: Rabbits will bring you additional combat rewards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-OOKUNINESHI_PROTRAYAL.fla: The dream lover of all rabbits.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WHITE_FLAG.title: White Flag
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WHITE_FLAG.description: Upon pickup, choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] that costs at least [blue]1[/blue], and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WHITE_FLAG.eventDescripti: Upon pickup, choose a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] that costs at least [blue]1[/blue], and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SUSPICIOUS_TOKEN.title: Suspicious Token
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SUSPICIOUS_TOKEN.descript: At each shop, you may refresh the [gold]Merchant's[/gold] wares once for free. Afterwards, all items are [blue]{Discount}% off[/blue]!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SUSPICIOUS_TOKEN.flavor: Hand this to the merchant for a special service—when you think Tewi Inaba has tricked you, but actually hasn't, does that still count as being tricked?
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INVISIBILITY_CLOTH.title: Invisibility Cloth
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INVISIBILITY_CLOTH.descri: At the start of each combat, gain [gold]Barricade[/gold], [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. The first time you take unblocked damage each combat, lose [gold]Barricade[/gold] and enter [purple]Ringing[/purple] for 1 turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-INVISIBILITY_CLOTH.flavor: Although it can conceal one's form, the cloth itself remains visible.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLOOD_YIN_YANG_ORB.title: Blood Yin-Yang Orb
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLOOD_YIN_YANG_ORB.descri: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.  [gold]Rest[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold] heals [blue]{HealPenalty}[/blue] less HP.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLOOD_YIN_YANG_ORB.flavor: A small inscription on the back reads: This relic give you more chance to Upgrade cards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-REBELLION_HORN.title: Rebellion Horn
TOUHOUANCIENTS-REBELLION_HORN.descriptio: Upon pickup, [green]Upgrade[/green] ALL [gold]Starter[/gold] and [gold]Common[/gold] cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-REBELLION_HORN.flavor: Seija once tried to recruit Mazaleth's followers to join her rebel army, but was rejected because the horn couldn't make a 'Caaaaw' sound.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BATTERY_BILI.title: Zap Battery
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BATTERY_BILI.description: At the start of the first turn of each combat, choose [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Power[/gold] cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to put into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. They are free to play this turn and gain [purple]Galvanized[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BATTERY_BILI.eventDescrip: At the start of the first turn of each combat, choose [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Power[/gold] cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to put into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. They are free to play this turn and gain [purple]Galvanized[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BATTERY_BILI.selectionScr: Choose [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Power cards to put into your Hand, making them free to play this turn and gain [purple]Galvanized[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BATTERY_BILI.flavor: Bad news, the battery is leaking. Good news, at least batteries can't cast [gold]Voltaic[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GHOST_LANTERN.title: Ghost Lantern
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GHOST_LANTERN.description: Upon pickup, choose up to [blue]{SelectNum}[/blue] of [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Colorless[/gold] cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]enchanted[/gold] with [purple]{EnchantmentName} {EnchantAmount}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GHOST_LANTERN.eventDescri: Choose up to [blue]{SelectNum}[/blue] of [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Colorless[/gold] cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]enchanted[/gold] with [purple]{EnchantmentName} {EnchantAmount}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GHOST_LANTERN.selectionSc: Choose up to [blue]{SelectNum}[/blue] cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GHOST_LANTERN.flavor: The souls dwelling within [jitter]stir[/jitter]. In every way, a ghost surpasses the physical body... no, I'm not referring to anyone in particular.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MAGIC_MALLET.title: Magic Mallet
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MAGIC_MALLET.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Mallet's Magic[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MAGIC_MALLET.flavor: A treasure of the Oni, held by the ruler of Shining Needle Castle.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FOLDING_UMBRELLA.title: Folding Umbrella
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FOLDING_UMBRELLA.descript: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Reflect[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FOLDING_UMBRELLA.flavor: Ghost story: Please don't end your turn with more than 17 Block.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HUNGRY_BACKPACK.title: Hungry Backpack
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HUNGRY_BACKPACK.descripti: At the start of each turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional cards and cause [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random cards drawn during the [gold]Draw Phase[/gold] to gain [purple]Devoured[/purple] this turn. Then reduce both values by [blue]{ReduceCardDraw}[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HUNGRY_BACKPACK.flavor: You can faintly hear the sound of 'I Hunger……' coming from within the backpack.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FAKE_SPIRIT_ORB.title: Fake Occult Ball
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FAKE_SPIRIT_ORB.descripti: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.  [blue]{Amount}[/blue] random cards drawn during the [gold]Draw Phase[/gold] gain [purple]Weighted[/purple] this turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FAKE_SPIRIT_ORB.flavor: Wearing this won't attract aliens or high school girls.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-FAKE_SPIRIT_ORB.extra: Lose {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} when you play this card.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DREAM_HEAVEN_BOW.title: Dream Heaven Bow
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DREAM_HEAVEN_BOW.descript: At the start of each combat, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies. Deal damage [blue]2[/blue] additional times to the enemy with the highest HP and apply [blue]{Weak}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DREAM_HEAVEN_BOW.flavor: Too bad you can't enchant it with "Infinity" or "Flame"…
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CHILDHOOD_BAG.title: Childhood Bag
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CHILDHOOD_BAG.description: Upon pickup, fill all empty [gold]Potion Slots[/gold] with [purple]Foul Potion[/purple]. Replace combat [gold]Gold[/gold] rewards with [blue]{PotionCount}[/blue] [purple]Foul Potion[/purple]. Thrown [purple]Foul Potion[/purple] only damages enemies.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CHILDHOOD_BAG.eventDescri: Fill all empty [gold]Potion Slots[/gold] with [purple]Foul Potion[/purple]. Replace combat [gold]Gold[/gold] rewards with [blue]{PotionCount}[/blue] [purple]Foul Potion[/purple]. Thrown [purple]Foul Potion[/purple] only damages enemies.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CHILDHOOD_BAG.flavor: Ten little nameless dolls went off to school; one was swept away by the rushing foul river and then there were nine.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-STAGE_DEVICE.title: Stage Device
TOUHOUANCIENTS-STAGE_DEVICE.description: At the start of odd turns, apply [blue]{VulnAmount}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies and gain [blue]{TempStr}[/blue] temporary [gold]Strength[/gold]. At the start of even turns, apply [blue]{WeakAmount}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies and gain [blue]{TempDex}[/blue] temporary [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-STAGE_DEVICE.flavor: Nine little nameless dolls danced at the ball; one kept dancing and then there were eight.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MEDICINE_POISON_BOX.title: Toxic Chemical Box
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MEDICINE_POISON_BOX.descr: Upon pickup, Transform all [gold]Strikes[/gold] in your [gold]Deck[/gold] into [gold]Snakebite[/gold] and [gold]enchant[/gold] them with [purple]Toxic 3[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MEDICINE_POISON_BOX.event: Transform all [gold]Strikes[/gold] in your [gold]Deck[/gold] into [gold]Snakebite[/gold] and [gold]enchant[/gold] them with [purple]Toxic 3[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MEDICINE_POISON_BOX.flavo: Eight little nameless dolls found a great chest in the bamboo forest; one tripped its venomous snake hidden trap and then there were seven.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LILY_BELL_DIARY.title: Lily's Diary
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LILY_BELL_DIARY.descripti: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Lily Bell[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LILY_BELL_DIARY.flavor: One little nameless doll was left at last; she slept alone in the lily field and then there were none.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAPPINESS_ELIXIR.title: Happiness Elixir
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAPPINESS_ELIXIR.descript: Upon pickup, obtain a [green]Camellia[/green]. After defeating the Act [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Boss[/gold], an extra [green]Camellia[/green] drops.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAPPINESS_ELIXIR.eventDes: Obtain a [green]Camellia[/green]. After defeating the Act [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Boss[/gold], an extra [green]Camellia[/green] drops.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HAPPINESS_ELIXIR.flavor: Two little nameless dolls, shaken, sought calm; one took too much of the potion and then there was one.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RIBBON_BOW.title: Ribbon Bow
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RIBBON_BOW.description: Upon pickup, add a [gold]Grudge[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Choose [blue]{SelectCount}[/blue] Attacks or Skills from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]enchant[/gold] them with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RIBBON_BOW.eventDescripti: Add a [gold]Grudge[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Choose [blue]{SelectCount}[/blue] Attacks or Skills from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [gold]enchant[/gold] them with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RIBBON_BOW.flavor: Seven little nameless dolls dressed up to compete; one was slain by a jealous hand and then there were six.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ROSE_CROWN.title: Rose Crown
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ROSE_CROWN.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{ThornsAmount}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold] and [blue]{PlatingAmount}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ROSE_CROWN.flavor: Six little nameless dolls vied for the throne, drunk on power; one was undone by a black-hearted reporter's rumors and then there were five.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MALICIOUS_FAIRY_TALE.desc: At the start of each combat, ALL enemies gain [blue]{ThornsAmount}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold]. At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{Power}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MALICIOUS_FAIRY_TALE.flav: Four little nameless dolls roamed the magic woods; one lost the way and then there were three.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PLAGUE_BLEND.title: Blight Blend
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PLAGUE_BLEND.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.  At the start of turn [blue]{TriggerTurn}[/blue], apply [blue]{PoisonAmount}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to yourself.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PLAGUE_BLEND.flavor: Five little nameless dolls drank at the black market; one was knocked out by the wine and then there were four.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SILENCE_DOLL.title: Silence Doll
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SILENCE_DOLL.description: At the start of each turn, choose a card that entered [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] last turn and put it into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It gains [gold]Retain[/gold] until played.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SILENCE_DOLL.selectionScr: Choose a card to put into your Hand.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SILENCE_DOLL.flavor: Three little nameless dolls crossed a witch's door; one was made a voiceless puppet and then there were two.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-REPOSITORY_OF_HIROKAWA.de: At the end of your turn, if you only played [gold]Powers[/gold] this turn, gain [blue]{BufferAmount}[/blue] [gold]Buffer[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SKY_HAT.title: Sky Hat
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SKY_HAT.description: Whenever you gain [blue]{BlockPerIntangible}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Soul+[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SOUL_BUTTERFLY.title: Soul Butterfly
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SOUL_BUTTERFLY.descriptio: When your HP would be reduced to [blue]0[/blue], heal to [blue]{ReviveHp}[/blue] HP, gain [blue]{IntangibleAmount}[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold], then become dormant for [blue]{DormantTurns}[/blue] turns.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DANMUKU_GHOST.title: Danmaku Ghost
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DANMUKU_GHOST.description: At the end of an enemy's turn, if it attacked but dealt no damage, apply [blue]{ShrinkAmount}[/blue] [gold]Shrink[/gold] to it.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GHOST_FAN.title: Ghost Fan
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GHOST_FAN.description: Upon pickup, choose up to [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Skills[/gold] and [gold]enchant[/gold] them with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GHOST_FAN.eventDescriptio: Choose up to [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Skills[/gold] and [gold]enchant[/gold] them with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold]. You may [pink]Hanami[/pink] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SOUL_SAKE_CUP.title: Sake Cup
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SOUL_SAKE_CUP.description: Upon pickup, increase your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHpGain}[/blue], then set your HP to [blue]{SetHp}[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SOUL_SAKE_CUP.eventDescri: Increase your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHpGain}[/blue], then set your HP to [blue]{SetHp}[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SOUL_LATTERN.title: Soul Lantern
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SOUL_LATTERN.description: The first time any unit's HP drops below [blue]50%[/blue] each combat, enter [gold]Reaper Form[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SOUL_LATTERN.flavor: Death is a cool summer night, where one may sleep without a care.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TICKET_TO_NETHERWORLD.des: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]All Living Things Must Perish[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TICKET_TO_NETHERWORLD.eve: Add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]All Living Things Must Perish[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SAIGYOUJI_BRANCH.title: Saigyouji Withered Branch
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SAIGYOUJI_BRANCH.descript: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, add a random card with [gold]Ethereal[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold] and gain [blue]{BlockAmount}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KONSHII_NO_KUSURI.title: Ultramarine Orb Elixir
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KONSHII_NO_KUSURI.descrip: At the start of each combat, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Ultramarine Orb Elixir[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RYUKEI_NO_TAMA.title: Jewel from the Dragon's Neck
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RYUKEI_NO_TAMA.descriptio: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Seven Stars+[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It has [gold]Retain[/gold]. At the end of your turn, or every [blue]{Card}[/blue] cards you play, reduce its [gold]Stars[/gold] cost by [blue]1[/blue] this combat.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HINEZUMI_NO_KAWAGOROMO.de: At the start of combat, add [blue]{BurnCount}[/blue] [gold]Burn[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. When you take damage from [gold]Burn[/gold], negate it and gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and [blue]{Thorns}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold], next turn, draw [blue]1[/blue] extra card.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TSUBAME_NO_KOYASUGAI.desc: Upon pickup, increase your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHpGain}[/blue]. Upon entering a new room, if your HP is below [blue]40%[/blue], heal to [blue]40%[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TSUBAME_NO_KOYASUGAI.even: Increase your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHpGain}[/blue]. Upon entering a new room, if your HP is below [blue]40%[/blue], heal to [blue]40%[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HOTOKE_MISHI_ISHI_NO_HACH: Upon pickup, lose [blue]{MaxHpLoss}[/blue] Max HP. At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{Dexterity}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and [blue]{StartBlock}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
Lose [blue]{MaxHpLoss}[/blue] Max HP. At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{Dexterity}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and [blue]{StartBlock}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
The diamond of a Buddha’s body.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HOURAI_NO_TAMAE.title: Jeweled Branch of Hourai
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HOURAI_NO_TAMAE.descripti: At the start of each combat, [gold]enchant[/gold] [blue]{EnchantCount}[/blue] random cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [purple]Dreamy[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HOURAI_NO_TAMAE.flavor: Branches of silver, stems of gold, and fruits of jade.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-EIENTEI_ZAKUSHI.title: Eientei Zakushi
TOUHOUANCIENTS-EIENTEI_ZAKUSHI.descripti: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] [gold]Potion Slot[/gold] and fill all empty [gold]Potion Slots[/gold] with random [gold]Potions[/gold]. At the start of your turn, for each [gold]Potion[/gold] you have, deal [blue]{DamagePerPotion}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-EIENTEI_ZAKUSHI.eventDesc: Gain [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] [gold]Potion Slot[/gold] and fill all empty [gold]Potion Slots[/gold] with random [gold]Potions[/gold]. At the start of your turn, for each [gold]Potion[/gold] you have, deal [blue]{DamagePerPotion}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KAGUYA_SECRET_TREASURE.de: At the start of each combat, choose one of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [green]Upgraded[/green] cards from other characters' pools and add it to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. After playing this card, its original copy additionally appears in [gold]combat rewards[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KAGUYA_SECRET_TREASURE.fl: For an eternal life, saving up is naturally the most important thing.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MINI_HAKKERO.title: Mini Hakkero
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MINI_HAKKERO.description: At end of turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] [blue]1~3[/blue] cards from your [gold]Hand[/gold]. If at least [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card(s) were exhausted, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MINI_HAKKERO.flavor: A magical weapon that focuses magical waves into one point and fires them forward.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LOVE_COLOR_FLASHLIGHT.des: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Master Spark[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-LOVE_COLOR_FLASHLIGHT.fla: If it's not flashy, it's not magic! The most important thing about danmaku is firepower Da☆Ze!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-COMET_ACCELERATOR.title: Comet Accelerator
TOUHOUANCIENTS-COMET_ACCELERATOR.descrip: At the start of each turn, draw [blue]2[/blue] additional cards and add [blue]{DazeNum}[/blue] [gold]Daze[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-COMET_ACCELERATOR.flavor: The speed required to escape the Scarlet Devil Mansion while carrying books is 11.2 meters per second.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KOMPEITO_POT.title: Konpeito Pot
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KOMPEITO_POT.description: Your [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] contain an additional [green]Upgraded[/green] [gold]Power[/gold]. Expires after [blue]3[/blue] picks.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KOMPEITO_POT.flavor: Eat too much and watch out for cavities!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-STARDUST_BROOM.title: Stardust Broom
TOUHOUANCIENTS-STARDUST_BROOM.descriptio: Start with [blue]2[/blue] charges, max [blue]3[/blue] charges. You may ignore paths when choosing the next rooms to travel to, consuming [blue]1[/blue] charge per use. Gain [blue]1[/blue] charge every [blue]3[/blue] rooms.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-STARDUST_BROOM.flavor: There was never a magic broom in this world, but when enough people ride it, it becomes one.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WITCHS_CAULDRON.title: Witch's Cauldron
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WITCHS_CAULDRON.descripti: Upon pickup, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Potion Slots[/gold]. You may [gold]Brew[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WITCHS_CAULDRON.eventDesc: Gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Potion Slots[/gold]. You may [gold]Brew[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WITCHS_CAULDRON.flavor: The cauldron has a lingering smell of mushrooms that just won't wash off.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-UNSTABLE_BOTTLE.title: Unstable Bottle
TOUHOUANCIENTS-UNSTABLE_BOTTLE.descripti: At the start of each turn, randomly [gold]enchant[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] card in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] with [purple]Glam[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-UNSTABLE_BOTTLE.flavor: Please don't go poking around under a maiden's skirt, okay?
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BOTTLED_GALAXY.title: Miniature Milky Way
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GLOBE.title: Globe
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GLOBE.flavor: The night stretches cool as water, as I sit and watch the Weaver and the Cowherd stars.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MUSHROOM_BENTO.title: Mushroom Bento
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MUSHROOM_BENTO.descriptio: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.  At the end of your turn, if you have at least [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold], add a [gold]Spore Mind[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MUSHROOM_BENTO.flavor: Rice cooked with Hakkero firepower, topped with a soup made from days of secret-recipe-brewed (massive amounts of) edible mushrooms. A feast for both the eyes and the palate.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MUSHROOM_BENTO.mushroom: Marisa's mushroom cooking has been put to good use—no negative effects will occur.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PURE_CONFIDENCE.title: Pure Confidence
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PURE_CONFIDENCE.descripti: Upon pickup, replace the Act [blue]3[/blue] map with a [red]perilous[/red] straight path filled with Elites and treasure. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CEASELESS_RESENTMENT.desc: When you take damage from an enemy, apply [gold]Resentment[/gold] to that enemy equal to the HP lost, sourced from you.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MURDEROUS_LILY.title: Murderous Lily
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MURDEROUS_LILY.descriptio: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Killing Lunacy[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. At the end of combat, if no unit died from [gold]Killing Lunacy[/gold], add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Killing Aura[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MURDEROUS_LILY.eventDescr: Add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Killing Lunacy[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. At the end of combat, if no unit died from [gold]Killing Lunacy[/gold], add {Cards} [gold]Killing Lunacy[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DEATH_BLACK_CROWN.title: Death Black Crown
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DEATH_BLACK_CROWN.descrip: The first [blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue] cards you play each turn deal double damage.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HELL_OF_BULLETS.title: Hell of Bullets
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HELL_OF_BULLETS.descripti: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]A Pristine Danmaku Hells[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HELL_OF_BULLETS.eventDesc: Add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]A Pristine Danmaku Hell[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TREMBLING_FROZEN_STAR.des: Every [blue]{AttackThreshold}[/blue] Attacks played, [gold]Channel[/gold] a [gold]Frost[/gold] Orb, and alternately add a [gold]Tremble[/gold] / [gold]Dominate[/gold] with [gold]Ethereal[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ILLUSORY_PROJECTION.title: Illusory Projection
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ILLUSORY_PROJECTION.descr: Start each combat [red]Confused[/red]. Cards costing [blue]{CostThreshold}[/blue] or more are played [blue]2[/blue] times.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-OVERFLOWING_DEFILEMENT.de: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional cards. At the end of your turn, for each non-Status card in your [gold]Hand[/gold], add a [gold]Debris[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]; for each Energy, add a [gold]Void[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PRIMAL_SPIRIT.title: Primal Spirit
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PRIMAL_SPIRIT.description:
At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{IntangibleAmount}[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold]. At the start of each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} equal to the current turn number.
[red]At the start of turn [blue]{TriggerTurn}[/blue], gain The Gambit.[/red]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PRIMAL_SPIRIT.eventDescri: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{IntangibleAmount}[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold]. At the start of each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} equal to the current turn number.[red]At the start of turn [blue]{TriggerTurn}[/blue], gain The Gambit.[/red]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BOTTOMLESS_STOMACH.title: Bottomless Stomach
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BOTTOMLESS_STOMACH.descri: Upon pickup, Devour all relics other than your Starter Relic and Ancient Relics. Each grants [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold]. Every [blue]{StrengthTrigger}[/blue] relics grant [blue]{Strength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], [blue]{Dexterity}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], and [blue]{Focus}[/blue] [gold]Focus[/gold]. Every [blue]{EnergyTrigger}[/blue] relics grant {Energy:energyIcons()}. Every [blue]{DrawTrigger}[/blue] relics grant [blue]{CardsPerTurn}[/blue] additional draw each turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BOTTOMLESS_STOMACH.flavor: Whether physical or spiritual, organic or inorganic — anything and everything goes straight down her gullet.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GLUTTONOUS_FANG.title: Gluttonous Jaws
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GLUTTONOUS_FANG.descripti: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]The Feast[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLOODLICKING_TONGUE.title: Bloodlicking Tongue
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLOODLICKING_TONGUE.descr: Whenever you lose [blue]{Threshold}[/blue] HP, gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold] and [blue]{Strength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLOODLICKING_TONGUE.flavo: Not enough, not enough, not enough! I need more...
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SKY_SWALLOWING_SPOON.desc: Whenever you add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]enchant[/gold] that card with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple]. After the next combat ends, [red]Swallowed[/red] it and gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold]. If it's a [red]Curse[/red], triple effect.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RIGID_DESIRE_PROOF.title: Gouyoku Proof
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RIGID_DESIRE_PROOF.descri: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.  You cannot play [blue]{TypeLimit}[/blue] cards of the same type in a row per turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RIGID_DESIRE_PROOF.flavor: Might makes right. Survival of the fittest is the law of beasts.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GREEDY_EYE.title: Greedy Eye
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GREEDY_EYE.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Hidden Gem[/gold] [gold]enchanted[/gold] with [purple]Obsession[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GREEDY_EYE.flavor: A greed like no other is quite filling, you know.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CURSED_BLOOD.title: Cursed Blood
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CURSED_BLOOD.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Decay[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. At the start of each of your turns, brew [blue]{PotionCount}[/blue] potions and drink them immediately.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CURSED_BLOOD.eventDescrip: Add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Decay[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. At the start of each of your turns, brew [blue]{PotionCount}[/blue] potions and drink them immediately.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CURSED_BLOOD.flavor: The fear, joy, hatred, and lament of life — all of it is what oil, the blood of the earth, truly is.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PURGATORY_EMBERS.title: Purgatory Embers
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PURGATORY_EMBERS.descript: At the start of your turn, choose any number of cards from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] to put into your [gold]Hand[/gold], add [gold]Ethereal[/gold] to them, then add that many [gold]Burn[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PURGATORY_EMBERS.flavor: "(Yawn—) Says they're gonna conquer the world, yet here they are, lazing around just like me." — Chiyari Tenkajin
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PURGATORY_EMBERS.selectio: Choose any number of cards to put into your Hand
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GUILTLESS_FACE.title: Guiltless Face
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GUILTLESS_FACE.descriptio: Upon pickup, choose a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Transform ALL cards of the same type in your [gold]Deck[/gold] into it.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GUILTLESS_FACE.eventDescr: Choose a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Transform ALL cards of the same type in your [gold]Deck[/gold] into it.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GUILTLESS_FACE.selectionS: Choose a card to Transform ALL cards of the same type in your Deck into it.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GUILTLESS_FACE.flavor: Most members of the Gouyoku Alliance are a bunch of self-serving rogues.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ESTRANGED_HEART.title: Estranged Heart
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ESTRANGED_HEART.descripti: After the Draw Phase, choose any number of cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to put into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. After accumulating [blue]{Threshold}[/blue] cards obtained this way, this relic expires at the end of this combat.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ESTRANGED_HEART.selection: Choose any number of cards to put into your Hand
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ESTRANGED_HEART.flavor: This Undefeated Matriarch of the Gouyoku Alliance refuses no food whatsoever — but only deep-fried tofu can make her halt her tearing fangs.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-POSSESSION_SPIRIT.title: Possession Spirit
TOUHOUANCIENTS-POSSESSION_SPIRIT.descrip: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Opulence Form[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Destitution Form[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-POSSESSION_SPIRIT.eventDe: Add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Opulence Form[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Destitution Form[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PURE_GOLD_BRACELET.title: Pure Gold Bracelet
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PURE_GOLD_BRACELET.descri: At the start of each turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional cards, then [gold]Discard[/gold] any non-X-cost cards drawn this way that cost less than [blue]{Threshold}[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PURE_GOLD_BRACELET.flavor: Money is meant to be passed from one hand to the next. Who do you think you are, trying to save it up?
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CHANEL_HANDBAG.title: Chanel Handbag
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CHANEL_HANDBAG.descriptio: [gold]Enchant[/gold] all cards for sale in shops with [purple]Glam[/purple].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CHANEL_HANDBAG.flavor: Come on, give me your gold.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-JYOON_FAN.title: Juliana Fan
TOUHOUANCIENTS-JYOON_FAN.description: At the start of non-Elite combats, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], [blue]{Strength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], [blue]{Dexterity}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], and [blue]{Focus}[/blue] [gold]Focus[/gold]. This relic expires after [blue]{Charges}[/blue] non-Elite combats. Gain [blue]{Charges}[/blue] additional charges after each Elite kill.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MILLION_POUNDS.title: Million Pounds
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MILLION_POUNDS.descriptio: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Plague Check[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLACK_CAT_DOLL.title: Black Cat Doll
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLACK_CAT_DOLL.descriptio: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. At the start of each turn, [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] are [gold]Afflicted with[/gold] [purple]Collateral[/purple] [blue]{CollateralNum}[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLACK_CAT_DOLL.flavor: If you keep resting on your laurels, you'll be penniless in no time...
TOUHOUANCIENTS-OIL_FUTURES.title: Oil Futures
TOUHOUANCIENTS-OIL_FUTURES.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Every [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random [red]Curses[/red] to add to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-OIL_FUTURES.flavor: The torrent of Doom flows within this black blood.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-OIL_FUTURES.selectionScre: Choose a [red]Curse[/red] to add to your Hand
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SMOKED_FAN.title: Smoked Fan
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SMOKED_FAN.description: ALL Elite enemies have [blue]1[/blue] HP. Whenever you defeat an Elite, add a [red]Guilty[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GRILLED_MISO.title: Grilled Miso
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GRILLED_MISO.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards. [green]Upgraded[/green] cards will no longer appear in combat rewards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GRILLED_MISO.eventDescrip: [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards. [green]Upgraded[/green] cards will no longer appear in combat rewards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-GRILLED_MISO.flavor: Oh~ real grilled miso... now that's the good stuff~
At the start of your turn, randomly add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Minion Dive[/gold], [gold]Minion Strike[/gold], or [gold]Minion Defend[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CRIMSON_CLOUD_KNUCKLES.de: When you play an [gold]Attack[/gold] card (not via Auto-Play), randomly play another [gold]Attack[/gold] card from your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-CRIMSON_CLOUD_KNUCKLES.fl: The ability to have precise movements and overwhelming strength.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SUNKEN_ANCHOR_GHOST.title: Sunken Anchor Ghost
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SUNKEN_ANCHOR_GHOST.descr: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. At the start of each combat, place [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random cards into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SUNKEN_ANCHOR_GHOST.flavo: The ability to make any ship sink no matter what.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WICKED_HERMIT_HAIRPIN.des: The first time you die each combat, heal [blue]{Percent}%[/blue] HP. Seiga Kaku takes over for subsequent turns.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WICKED_HERMIT_HAIRPIN.sei: After Seiga Kaku takes over, lose [blue]6[/blue] HP and gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of your turn. She prefers higher-cost cards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WICKED_HERMIT_HAIRPIN.fla: The ability to make zombies appear on your lawn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-NIDOMITEI_SPECIAL_BLEND.d: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] [gold]Potion Slots[/gold]. All [gold]Potions[/gold] you obtain become [gold]Super ZUN Beer[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-NIDOMITEI_SPECIAL_BLEND.e: Gain [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] [gold]Potion Slots[/gold]. All [gold]Potions[/gold] you obtain become [gold]Super ZUN Beer[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-NIDOMITEI_SPECIAL_BLEND.f: The ability to grow braver after a drink.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DOWSING_ROD.title: Dowsing Rod
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DOWSING_ROD.description: Unchosen [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] are recorded. You may hire Nazrin for [gold]treasure hunting[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DOWSING_ROD.flavor: The ability to find her pagoda no matter what.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DRAGON_VEIN_VESSEL.title: Dragon Vein Vessel
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DRAGON_VEIN_VESSEL.descri: Mark [blue]1[/blue] path (does not include Boss rooms). Entering nodes on the path grants [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]; if it is a combat, gain [blue]{Strength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{Dexterity}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] at the start, and gain [blue]{CardRewards}[/blue] extra [gold]Card Rewards[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DRAGON_VEIN_VESSEL.flavor: The ability to read feng shui and ignite it.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DISILLUSION_TRIDENT.title: Disillusion Trident
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DISILLUSION_TRIDENT.descr: Upon pickup, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Unidentified Youkai[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ONE_EYED_KARAKASA.title: One-Eyed Karakasa
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ONE_EYED_KARAKASA.descrip: Whenever you kill a non-Minion enemy, gain [blue]{Charges}[/blue] charges ([blue]{FirstTurnCharges}[/blue] if it is the first turn of combat). At [gold]Rest Sites[/gold], you may spend [blue]{UpgradeCost}[/blue] charges to [green]Upgrade[/green] [blue]{UpgradeCount}[/blue] additional cards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-ONE_EYED_KARAKASA.flavor: The ability to scare people yet still be adored by everyone.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HYAKKI_YAGYO_SCROLL.title: Hyakki Yagyo Scroll
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HYAKKI_YAGYO_SCROLL.descr: Upon pickup, view [blue]{CardPacks}[/blue] [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] from The Ironclad, The Silent, The Regent, The Necrobinder, and The Defect each. Combine the chosen [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] into a [gold]Card[/gold]: add [gold]Hyakki Yagyo[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HYAKKI_YAGYO_SCROLL.event: View [blue]{CardPacks}[/blue] [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] from The Ironclad, The Silent, The Regent, The Necrobinder, and The Defect each. Combine the chosen [gold]Card Rewards[/gold] into a [gold]Card[/gold]: add [gold]Hyakki Yagyo[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PSYCHIC_TELEKINESIS.title: Psychic Telekinesis
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PSYCHIC_TELEKINESIS.descr: Whenever you draw a [gold]Power[/gold] card, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional cards. The first time you play a [gold]Power[/gold] each turn, add [blue]{Copies}[/blue] copies of it to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-PSYCHIC_TELEKINESIS.flavo: The ability to treat JK as a species.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-NOH_MASK.title: Noh Mask
TOUHOUANCIENTS-NOH_MASK.description: At the start of combat or whenever you shuffle your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], randomly add [purple]Joy[/purple], [purple]Anger[/purple], [purple]Sorrow[/purple], or [purple]Pleasure[/purple] to all cards. After playing [blue]{EmotionThreshold}[/blue] of each emotion, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TUNAKI_SMOKING_PIPE.title: Tanuki’s Smoking Pipe
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TUNAKI_SMOKING_PIPE.descr: At the end of your turn, [gold]Transform[/gold] any number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
